conditions.host: Linux x86_64, Intel Core i5-5575R @ 2.80GHz, 4 logical CPUs
conditions.frontend_timing: 15 serial alternating runs; excludes preprocessing, process startup, file input/output. Includes AST/token teardown. This microbenchmark isolates the declarator change and does not measure source-map improvements. No allocator instrumentation during timing.
conditions.allocation_scope: 3 runs each, full-process malloc/calloc/realloc requests, cumulative requested bytes and non-null free calls; includes startup/I/O, excludes aligned APIs. Not live/peak memory. No preprocessing in these probes.
conditions.canonical_ir: Sort complete function blocks and nonempty module-level lines; preserve instruction order inside functions. All four old/new inputs have identical canonical IR.
conditions.source_map_tradeoff: Store origins at contiguous-run boundaries. Count newlines within the run only when mapping a diagnostic; preserve original columns, UTF-8 boundaries and trailing-newline/EOF behavior. Reuse known unescaped marker filenames without allocation.
conditions.process_count: Process-only strace of a Git compilation confirms one Clang preprocessing process and one Clang IR lowering process. This change preserves that count.

origin_counts.method: Replay unchanged Clang line markers with an absolute main input path. Count origins at each normal line (before) vs first line following each marker group (after). Payload is count*24 for three usize fields on x86_64, excluding Vec spare capacity and all other source state; not peak RSS.

conditions.filesystem_cache: warm/not cleared, clean source copies before each timed build
conditions.runtime: All 3 compilers pass Redis PING/SET/GET/exact INCRBYFLOAT/HINCRBYFLOAT/Lua/cjson/SAVE/RDB restart and Git init/config/add/commit/status/log/switch/diff/gc/fsck smoke tests. GIT_EXEC_PATH points to each build directory.
conditions.max_rss: Maximum per-compilation process RSS, includes child processes; not peak whole-build RSS.
conditions.interpretation: Git improves in both runs (~0.9% median); Redis has no clear end-to-end gain. Two samples on one host/flag set, no statistical significance claim. Source-map stage sums are overlapping worker seconds, not wall times.
conditions.command_template: python3 tools/benchmarks/run.py --redis-source REDIS --git-source GIT --output NEW_DIRECTORY --clang clang-15 --baseline-dynamite SAVED_BASELINE --runs 2 --jobs 4
